messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Metric pipeline degraded — prom-scrapers failing with 5xx and log-ingest-consumer group lag >120k. Pager: <https://pagerduty.fake/INC12345|INC12345>

ajay (oncall): acked the page. I'm looking at grafana first.

maria (sre-lead): on call with you, ping me with anything customer facing. rough impact?

ajay (oncall): grafana shows scrape_errors spiking from eu-west scrape-job-legacy around 09:12UTC. Logs show repeated ECONNRESET to target endpoints. Also seeing a backlog on kafka topic logs-raw: consumer-group log-ingest-consumers lag 125k.

kai (platform): tagging in. querying node metrics and k8s events now.

ajay (oncall): dumping logs from prom-scraper pod:

```
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/prom-scraper -c prometheus-scraper --tail=200
# ... repeated: Get "https://10.0.2.14:9100/metrics": read tcp: connection reset by peer
```

ajay (oncall): also grabbed kafka lag:
```
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-consumers
# TOPIC     PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
# logs-raw  0          234500          359600          125100
```

kai (platform): i'm seeing disk pressure on node-12 in eu-west-1, kubelet eviction thresholds hit earlier. that could explain flaky scrape endpoints (node-local exporters dying). i'm going to scale prom-scraper replicas to move traffic off that node.

kai (platform): scaling now ->
```
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/prom-scraper --replicas=4
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -o wide | grep prom-scraper
```

ajay (oncall): scaled to 4, new pods coming up on nodes 14/15. restarting log-ingest-consumers (rolling restart) to rebalance partitions.

```
kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy/log-ingest-consumers
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ack recorded by ajay (oncall). Escalation policy: primary -> platform after 5m.

dana (support): CS reports a handful of customers seeing missing dashboards and no alert-triggered notifications since ~09:10UTC. I'm opening customer comms for affected accounts A123, B456.

maria (sre-lead): impact assessment: missing metrics and delayed logs => alerts suppressed for some customers. I'd classify as SEV2 (partial outage for monitoring). please set status page and customer comms.

ajay (oncall): post-action metrics: consumer lag dropped to ~32k after restart and rebalancing. prom scrape success rate improved to ~96% on new pods. still seeing intermittent failures to endpoints that remained on node-12.

kai (platform): i've cordoned node-12 and evicted noncritical pods. pvc on prometheus-exporter on that node was at 92% usage; working with infra to provision larger disk and reschedule.

maria (sre-lead): good. ajay keep watching for 15m, then hand off to @kai for remediation and RCA run. dana keep CS updated that mitigations are in progress.

ajay (oncall): monitoring window: consumer lag trending down, alerts starting to fire again. I'll leave a watch for 30m and then hand off.

kai (platform): i'm going to run a quick check for any remaining OOM kill or kernel logs around 09:00-09:20 to see root cause; also will check if a noisy scrape target caused cascade.

maria (sre-lead): can someone capture the pod eviction events and kubelet logs for node-12? that's likely helpful for postmortem.

ajay (oncall): saved events and pushed to the incident doc: <https://confluence.fake/incidents/INC12345|INC12345 incident doc> — includes: pod events, prom logs, kafka lag snapshots, and customer impact matrix.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalate to kai (platform) — acknowledged.

kai (platform): ack. continuing remediation and IO/FS checks. initial hypothesis: node disk pressure -> exporter restart -> scrape failures -> consumer backlog -> alerts suppressed.

maria (sre-lead): plan: 1) finish node remediation (kai), 2) increase prom-scraper replica baseline in eu-west, 3) run disk monitoring alert refinement so we alert before eviction thresholds, 4) postmortem to include runbook gaps + capacity adjustments.

ajay (oncall): handing off watch to kai in 30m. leaving short note in doc and marking as 'monitoring' status.

dana (support): CS comms sent to affected customers, will update on resolution note when stable.

maria (sre-lead): good job everyone. will schedule postmortem and assign action owners in the doc.

kai (platform): update at 09:50UTC: node-12 disk resize started, consumer lag down to 8k and falling, scrape success 99%. i'll keep watch and mark when fully resolved.

ajay (oncall): thanks — moving to standby.

kai (platform): final update 10:40UTC: all scrape targets stable, kafka consumer group lag cleared, no further customer reports. Incident status: mitigated. will run RCA and share in 24h. :white_check_mark:

maria (sre-lead): incident mitigated. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow. closing thread here.
